decisions.decision: Add a workflow, not another Bot
decisions.reason: Sorting commitments and preparing replies fits the existing coordination role. Mail access and sending are separate permissions.

decisions.decision: Add a workflow, not another Bot
decisions.reason: A supplied guide and dated release notes can be compared by Editor. Automated product inspection needs separate testing.

decisions.decision: Add a workflow, not another Bot
decisions.reason: Assessing evidence before a product decision fits Nova. Keep this separate from reproducing a bug or committing a roadmap.

decisions.decision: Do not duplicate an existing workflow
decisions.reason: The site already has a feedback-to-issues example. The new review-product-feedback example handles prioritization and customer evidence before issue writing.

potentialGaps.name: Customer support assistant
potentialGaps.reason: Ticket triage, policy lookup, escalation and account-health review are not well represented by a dedicated standalone starter. A Customer Support Desk crew already exists; inspect it before proposing another role.
potentialGaps.next: Compare current crew responsibilities and build a single support task before deciding whether a standalone Bot is needed.

potentialGaps.name: Accessible image descriptions
potentialGaps.reason: Imogen has a specific accessibility job; general visual production is not proof of accessibility skill.
potentialGaps.next: Compare Visual Producer instructions and test descriptions against images before deciding whether this is a workflow or a distinct role.

potentialGaps.name: New-hire onboarding
potentialGaps.reason: A checklist is within Planner, but ongoing onboarding also needs ownership, policy boundaries and private employee data handling.
potentialGaps.next: Start with a supplied-material Planner workflow; only consider a specialist after finding a recurring unmet requirement.

potentialGaps.name: Evidence-based security questionnaires
potentialGaps.reason: Reusable answers need dated approved evidence and reliable handling of unknown controls.
potentialGaps.next: Investigate as a Client Deliverables workflow; never infer a security control or submit answers automatically.

teams.rule: Use complementary responsibilities or independent checks, not arbitrary Bot counts.

examples.addReviewerWhen: Add Change Reviewer only when checking the running product or the proposed site change independently.

examples.qualification: Only use all three when the job actually includes deciding what matters, reproducing a failure and implementing an approved fix. A feedback summary alone does not need this crew.
A multi-source publication may benefit from separate research and review. A short supplied-material update may need only Writer.

limits: Source descriptions were reviewed, not full exports of all templates.
The archetype assignment groups existing roles; it does not prove those roles are redundant.
No new workflow runtime or connected-account test is claimed.
